recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-15680. Handle FHIR-29268 or FHIR-34417 separately if those issue-specific audits are desired; they were used only as context here.
issue_request: FHIR-15680 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core datatypes correction reporting that Period per-1 compared raw start/end string values and did not account for daylight savings/time-zone ordering. It requested changing the XPath comparison to xs:dateTime(f:start/@value) <= xs:dateTime(f:end/@value).
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 7b9942d50e2fc3424002e4358e33e568505b1657, 'GF#15680 - fix invariant', corresponding to svn revision 13438. That commit changed source/datatypes/period.xml from raw @value comparison to xs:dateTime casts.
additional_context: The current authoritative source row in source/datatypes/period.xml is in the datatype build scope for the datatypes page. Later Published issues FHIR-29268 and FHIR-34417 changed the same per-1 row's English text and FHIRPath expression, but neither removed the FHIR-15680 XPath cast. Historical tools/history/release2 and release3 profile snapshots still show the old XPath, but those are frozen history artifacts rather than current datatype source inputs.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source/datatypes/period.xml already has xs:dateTime(f:start/@value) <= xs:dateTime(f:end/@value) in the Period per-1 XPath, with later lower-or-equal text and lowBoundary()/highBoundary() FHIRPath expression preserved.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the same Period per-1 English text to allow equality, explaining the current 'lower or equal' wording.
Changed the same Period per-1 FHIRPath expression to lowBoundary()/highBoundary() for differing precision dateTimes while leaving the FHIR-15680 XPath cast intact.
